paper_title: NExtLong Toward Effective Long-Context Training without Long Documents
caption: NExtLong reduces the model's dependence on proximal text. We calculated the degree of dependence on proximal text (the last third of the text) for different methods when completing the LongQA task. It can be observed that NExtLong significantly reduces the model's dependence on proximal text.

The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Attention Weight,” using a linear scale ranging from 0.80 to 0.90 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.02 intervals (0.80, 0.82, 0.84, 0.86, 0.88, 0.90). Each method is represented by one light blue bar: Standard is approximately 0.865, ICLM is approximately 0.854, KNN is approximately 0.864, Quest is approximately 0.863, and NExtLong is approximately 0.827.
